    if isinstance(params, Symbol):

            cur = cur.cdr
        if isinstance(cur, Symbol):

            frame.bind(cur, list_to_scheme(args[i:]))
        elif isinstance(cur, NilType):

        else:

                    parts.append(' ')
                parts.append(elem)
            if not isinstance(cur, NilType):
                parts.append(' . ')
                parts.append(cur)
            parts.append(')')
            parts.insert(0, '(')
            for p in reversed(parts):
                stack.append(p)
        elif isinstance(item, NilType):
            out.append('()')
        elif isinstance(item, UnspecifiedType):
            pass
        elif isinstance(item, Str):
            if write_mode:
                out.append('"' + escape_string(item.val) + '"')

            out.append(item.name)

        elif isinstance(item, (Closure, Builtin)):
            out.append('#<procedure>')
        else:
